request: DebugAI focused hypothesis-evidence regression in isolated offline read-only container pinned to exact candidate source, no model/external review or production mutation

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
w="$p/.worktrees/hypothesis-review-evidence-20261028"
expected=e4040b3da34f53a5da5bd51dd47a10cb66b2b93c
[ "$(realpath "$w")" = "$w" ] && [ "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$expected" ] || { echo TEST_SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; exit 4; }
[ -f "$w/server/workflow.js" ] && [ -f "$w/server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs" ] || { echo TEST_FILES_MISSING; exit 4; }
image=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1)
echo "TEST_SOURCE_HEAD=$expected"
echo "TEST_RUNTIME_IMAGE=$image"
echo "TEST_MODE=ISOLATED_NO_NETWORK_READONLY"
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 64 --memory 512m --cpus 1 \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/server/workflow.js,target=/app/server/workflow.js,readonly" \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs,target=/app/server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs,readonly" \
 --entrypoint node "$image" \
 --test server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs server/tests/external-review-verdict-contract.test.cjs
echo FOCUSED_TESTS=PASS
